root_cause.text: The MPTCP timestamp sockopt propagation code used lock_sock_fast() (which is intended for atomic contexts) to wrap calls to sock_set_timestamp() and sock_set_timestamping(), but those helper functions can sleep, leading to a scheduling while atomic panic.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "Using lock_sock_fast() (atomic context) around sock_set_timestamp() and sock_set_timestamping() is unsafe, as both helpers can sleep." The patch replaces lock_sock_fast() with sleepable lock_sock()/release_sock() in the two affected functions (mptcp_setsockopt_sol_socket_tstamp and mptcp_setsockopt_sol_socket_timestamping) in net/mptcp/sockopt.c.
